stories.title: Do we really ‘hold tension’ in our hips?

en.title: Do we really 'hold tension' in our hips?
en.summary: While wellness communities often claim hips store emotional trauma, experts state there is no scientific evidence supporting this idea. Hip tightness has physical causes unrelated to psychological trauma.

stories.title: ‘You lose your childhood’: The hidden burden carried by 40,000 young WA carers

en.title: 'You lose your childhood': The hidden burden carried by 40,000 young WA carers
en.summary: A survey found approximately 40,000 young carers aged 12 to 25 in Australia report losing their childhood due to caregiving responsibilities. The findings highlight the significant personal impact on young people in caring roles.

stories.title: Middle East crisis live: Riyadh airport reportedly hit again, day after deadly attack that killed 12

en.title: Middle East crisis live: Riyadh airport reportedly hit again, day after deadly attack that killed 12
en.summary: A projectile struck a passenger terminal at Riyadh airport, igniting a fire, according to a Saudi-led coalition spokesperson. The UAE expressed solidarity with Saudi Arabia following the Houthi attack that killed 12 people the previous day.

stories.title: Andy Burnham says it is clear Russia interfered in Brexit referendum

en.title: Andy Burnham says it is clear Russia interfered in Brexit referendum
en.summary: The Prime Minister stated he sought confirmation about Russian interference in the 2016 Brexit referendum upon taking office and received affirmation that such meddling occurred, though he did not identify his source.

stories.title: Jaguars and Eagles have two players ejected after opening-kickoff brawl in London

en.title: Jaguars and Eagles have two players ejected after opening-kickoff brawl in London
en.summary: A confrontation during the opening kickoff of the Jacksonville Jaguars versus Philadelphia Eagles game in London resulted in two player ejections and a touchdown being nullified. The opening kickoff had to be replayed.

stories.title: Record-breaking quartet put Australia in full control against South Africa

en.title: Record-breaking quartet put Australia in full control against South Africa
en.summary: Australia's four senior bowlers—Starc, Hazlewood, Cummins, and Lyon—each with over 300 wickets and aged 33 or older, have achieved an unprecedented historic milestone. They continue a unique streak begun two months earlier, sharing nine wickets as Australia gains control in their Test match against South Africa.

stories.title: Australia vs South Africa LIVE: Smith’s four catches set record before Australia extend lead to 139

en.title: Australia vs South Africa LIVE: Smith's four catches set record before Australia extend lead to 139
en.summary: Smith equaled a catching record while Australia builds their lead after dismissing South Africa for 284 runs in Durban. Australia's advantage has grown to 139 runs in their Test match.

stories.title: Matt Renshaw's 190 turns Durban Test, providing Aussie batting blueprint

en.title: Matt Renshaw's 190 turns Durban Test, providing Aussie batting blueprint
en.summary: Australian cricketer Matt Renshaw scored 190 runs in a Test match in Durban, demonstrating the sustained batting performance Australian cricket fans have been seeking.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia's Riyadh airport out of action after third attack kills at least 12

en.title: Saudi Arabia's Riyadh airport out of action after third attack kills at least 12
en.summary: Riyadh airport has been shut down following a third attack that resulted in at least 12 deaths. The Australian embassy has advised travellers to avoid the country as numerous flights face cancellation and delays.

stories.title: South Melbourne stuns Melbourne Victory to claim Australia Cup

en.title: South Melbourne stuns Melbourne Victory to claim Australia Cup
en.summary: NPL side South Melbourne defeated A-League team Melbourne Victory in the Australia Cup final at AAMI Park, winning the title on penalties in a historic upset.

stories.title: Matt Renshaw’s epic 190 helps Australia turn tables on South Africa in Durban

en.title: Matt Renshaw's epic 190 helps Australia turn tables on South Africa in Durban
en.summary: Matt Renshaw scored 190 runs in his first Test century in nine years, enabling Australia to recover from a difficult position and establish dominance against South Africa. Lower-order batting support also contributed significantly to Australia's improved standing.

stories.title: South Melbourne make history with Australia Cup win that could change the future too | Joey Lynch

en.title: South Melbourne make history with Australia Cup win that could change the future too | Joey Lynch
en.summary: South Melbourne became the first non-A-League club to win the Australia Cup, defeating Melbourne Victory 4-3 on penalties after a 1-1 draw in extra time.

stories.title: Trump says Russia and Ukraine reach energy ceasefire ‘effective immediately’

en.title: Trump says Russia and Ukraine reach energy ceasefire 'effective immediately'
en.summary: Trump announced that Russia and Ukraine have reached an immediate energy ceasefire. Zelensky stated willingness to hold elections if Russia agrees to a broader ceasefire, while Houthi strikes on Riyadh airport have killed 12 people.

stories.title: Energy rulemaker backs ‘EV charger tax’ to boost switch from petrol

en.title: Energy rulemaker backs 'EV charger tax' to boost switch from petrol
en.summary: The Australian Energy Market Commission supports a proposal requiring households to fund electric vehicle chargers in underserved areas as a means to increase EV adoption and reduce emissions.

stories.title: Relentless rate rises put mortgage burden at levels last seen in 1989

en.title: Relentless rate rises put mortgage burden at levels last seen in 1989
en.summary: Interest rate increases have driven mortgage costs to levels not experienced since 1989. Economists express concern that some inflation drivers may not respond effectively to higher borrowing costs.

stories.title: Ex-football boss hit with new deception case over business sale

en.title: Ex-football boss hit with new deception case over business sale
en.summary: Former Sydney Olympic FC president Damon Hanlin faces legal claims involving forged documents and false revenue projections related to a $70 million company sale.

stories.title: Inside the Big Bash League’s pitch to privatise Melbourne Renegades

en.title: Inside the Big Bash League's pitch to privatise Melbourne Renegades
en.summary: The Big Bash League is marketing the privatisation of Melbourne Renegades, citing combined league and club revenues of $144 million last season with profit growth from $23 million to $31 million.
